svg.aria-label: Serverless Cache API. Read heavy catalog API on AWS: ALB, Lambda with cache aside and per key locks, ElastiCache and RDS PostgreSQL, provisioned with Terraform. Under a 300 requests per second load test, successful throughput rose 15x and p99 latency fell from 20 seconds to 132 milliseconds.
